description.en: ROH-A002 is OYMotion's anthropomorphic robotic end effector with five independently moving fingers, six active degrees of freedom and 11 moving joints. Integrated motor drivers and PID control support programmable pinching, grasping and gestures. The official page lists a 580 ±5 g mass, ±1 mm repeatability and UART, RS485 and CAN interfaces, alongside SDK, ROS, ROS2 and URDF support. Intended uses include humanoids, inspection robots and research equipment. The manufacturer's static finger-load and bent-finger lifting figures describe specific test conditions rather than unrestricted active gripping capability.
description.zh: 仿人五指机器人灵巧手，五指可分别运动，具有11个运动关节和6个主动自由度，内置电机控制支持编程抓握。

sources.title: oy-ROH-A002
sources.quote: The ROHAND dexterous hand has a total of 11 motion joints, with 6 built-in motor drivers and the motor control circuit. With 6 active degrees of freedom, and a built-in PID motor control algorithm, the hand can mimic the human hand to achieve a variety of grasping grips. Typical applications include robot end effectors, educational and scientific research equipment, bionic prosthetics, etc. ROH-A002 dexterous hand with UART, RS485 or CAN physical interface, support SerialCtrl dedicated serial protocol, ModBus-RTU protocol and CAN protocol, can provide ROS / ROS2 platforms for secondary development with SDK.
